title: App Builders Earn a Median of $135,980
description:
You tap apps all day. But what do their builders earn?

Sources:
- BLS OEWS via api.bls.gov: Software developers 15-1252, annual median wage, May 2025: https://api.bls.gov/publicAPI/v2/timeseries/data/OEUN000000000000015125213
- BLS OEWS via api.bls.gov: employment: https://api.bls.gov/publicAPI/v2/timeseries/data/OEUN000000000000015125201
- BLS OEWS via api.bls.gov: 10th percentile: https://api.bls.gov/publicAPI/v2/timeseries/data/OEUN000000000000015125211
- BLS OEWS via api.bls.gov: 90th percentile: https://api.bls.gov/publicAPI/v2/timeseries/data/OEUN000000000000015125215

BLS May 2025 (OEWS, occupation 15-1252 software developers): employment 1,687,890; median $135,980; 10th percentile $82,460; 90th percentile $214,670. 214,670 / 82,460 = about 2.6x (our math). Median = half earn more, half earn less. Not financial advice.

scenes.narration: You tap apps all day. But what do their builders earn?
They're software developers. Just in the U.S., about 1.7 million.
But pay varies. The median is 135,980 dollars.
Then the extremes. The lowest tenth earn under 82,460. The top tenth, over 214,670.
Same job. Yet over two and a half times the pay.
